Emergency Response

India SOS & Disaster Helplines

Tap CALL to start a phone call. Numbers are for India. For immediate danger, use 112.

🚨 Important National SOS Numbers

Unified Emergency

Police • Fire • Medical • other emergencies
CALL 112

Ambulance / Medical

National ambulance / emergency medical support
CALL 108

Police

Police emergency
CALL 100

Fire & Rescue

Fire and rescue emergency
CALL 101

State Disaster Control

Relief Commissioner / State disaster control room
CALL 1070

District disaster control room
CALL 1077

Road Accident

National road accident helpline
CALL 1073

Cyber fraud / cybercrime
CALL 1930

Child emergency support
CALL 1098

Women Helpline

Women in distress
CALL 181

Railway Assistance

Indian Railways security / medical assistance
CALL 139

Emergency LPG leakage support
CALL 1906

Maritime rescue / coastal emergency
CALL 1554

Elderline
